description: The bar chart illustrates the performance metric "NDCG@10," as indicated by the title, across four different categories. The horizontal axis displays the categories with slightly tilted labels; from left to right, the first label is obscured by a solid grey rectangle, followed by the text labels "- critiquing", "- scoring", and "- ranking". The vertical axis represents the numerical value of the metric on a linear scale, ranging from a minimum of 0.05 to a maximum of 0.25, with tick marks and corresponding horizontal grid lines at regular intervals of 0.05. The chart contains four vertical bars corresponding to the horizontal categories. The first bar, associated with the grey rectangle label, is visually emphasized in orange and is the tallest in the chart, reaching an approximate value of 0.21. The remaining three bars are colored blue. The bar for "- critiquing" has an approximate value of 0.19, the bar for "- scoring" is the shortest at roughly 0.075, and the bar for "- ranking" has a value of approximately 0.12. The bars are not sorted in a specific ascending or descending order, but the first category is distinctly highlighted through its unique orange color and the grey block covering its x-axis label.
